principles: CREATE ONCE. CLASSIFY ONCE. APPROVE ONCE. DISTRIBUTE MANY.
The music does not create the universe. The universe creates the music.
Reality level and certainty are separate dimensions.
No agent can silently make canon.

three_layers.WORLD: Public exploration surface. A doorway into the universe.
three_layers.ARCHIVE: Evidence, provenance, versions, contradictions and historical state.
three_layers.CENTRAL: Private creation, classification, relationship analysis, approval and distribution.

future_distribution_rule: Destinations consume approved canonical records; they never become the source of truth.
